question: How much would this bending plastic gripper cost to make?
answer: The gripper would cost just cents to make. It bends instead of using hinges, so it is a single piece of plastic. Injection molded, it would cost cents, and its flat shape could even be extruded and chopped off one gripper at a time.
move: One bending piece instead of many parts makes a machine cost cents.
